correctness.rationale: The normalized Fock projection has kernel K(z,w)=π^-1exp(z conjugate(w)-(|z|²+|w|²)/2). Trace powers 1,2,3 reduce to an area integral, a Gaussian displacement integral with rectangular overlap (A-|x|)_+(B-|y|)_+, and a four-real-variable three-point integral with intersection overlap (A-Δ(x,s))_+(B-Δ(y,t))_+. Exponential Gaussian tails justify removing truncations with O(exp(-cR²)). The complex three-point phase gives the explicitly inspected 4×4 quadratic M with det M=1 and C=M^-1/2, where pairwise real covariances have variance 1/2 and cross correlations consist of three zeros and six ±i/2. Analytic continuation of the absolute bivariate Gaussian identity H(ρ)=[sqrt(1-ρ²)+ρarcsinρ]/π leads to E[Δ(X)Δ(Y)]=3/(4π)(1+sqrt(5)-log φ); direct substitution cancels area and perimeter in Tr(T-3T²+2T³). Independent exact SymPy inversion and correlation reconstruction confirmed the matrix, pattern and numeric positive 0.11472437826741096. Finite matrix algebra alone does not prove complex-Gaussian continuation or trace tails; these are addressed by the analytic argument.
